interactions.note: The epitope of Fab170 on the CD98 heavy chain was determined from the single particle cryo-EM reconstruction of nanodisc-reconstituted LAT1–CD98hc complexed with Fab170, at a resolution of 3.83 Å. Inhibitor JPH203 was bound to the outward-facing pocket of LAT1. Fab170 was generated and used to add ﬁducial markers for single-particle analysis.
